interpretation.plain_speak: The same native state that predicts the threatened write also tells us whether the rescue is likely to last. In this stream, a post-refresh horizon of 16 always meant the save would fail later; horizons of 25–30 always meant the save survived to the end.
interpretation.north_star_question: Adds a potential intervention-quality signal: Wingless may be able to distinguish a temporary rescue from a durable one before committing to a bounded response.
